en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a mountain valley with a waterfall in the background, surrounded by forested slopes. In the foreground, there is a small settlement with several rustic buildings, a stone bridge over a stream, and a few people visible on the bridge. The text at the top reads 'Les Hautes-Pyrénées.' Additional text at the bottom identifies the scene as 'Cauterets - Buvettes de Mahourat, La Vallée de Lutour.'
